subject: User updates to Stan within CmdStan

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: User updates to Stan within CmdStan
parts:
[renamed subject]

Hi Fei,

Within CmdStan, it's really, really easy to update Stan. Here are two options:
1) From CmdStan, when calling make, set the STAN_HOME variable to your existing Stan folder. So, something like: "make STAN_HOME=/usr/daniel/dev/stan/ foo" where foo.stan is the model. Note: it needs the trailing forward slash.
2) From CmdStan, instead of setting the STAN_HOME variable, which defaults to "stan/", just make edits to the copy of Stan inside CmdStan.

Both options above also work when you're using git to manage branches.


Daniel

On Friday, August 8, 2014 8:41:19 PM UTC+2, Daniel Lee wrote:
Hi Fei,

Are you using CmdStan? If so, the instructions in the manual are off and you should be building from the CmdStan folder (not CmdStan/stan) and the make target is: make stan/src/models/basic_estimators/bernoulli

If you're trying to use Stan to build it (no CmdStan or RStan or PyStan), then that doesn't work and I'm going to need to fix the makefile to not attempt to build it.


Daniel
